open_responses.question: Is there anything else you would like us to know about the support you received or what would help next?
open_responses.text: When the landlord tried to raise the rent, my case manager helped me talk to him.

open_responses.question: Is there anything else you would like us to know about the support you received or what would help next?
open_responses.text: I learned to put rent first and plan the rest around it.

open_responses.question: Is there anything else you would like us to know about the support you received or what would help next?
open_responses.text: My kids have their own beds now. They sleep through the night.

open_responses.question: Is there anything else you would like us to know about the support you received or what would help next?
open_responses.text: Having someone check on us every week made me feel like I wasn't alone.

open_responses.question: Is there anything else you would like us to know about the support you received or what would help next?

open_responses.text: I got my son back into one school instead of switching every few months.
